name: Monaghan Medical ISO 14001 Certification and Stated Objectives
known_limitations: Certification and stated objectives do not establish line output, yield, scrap, downtime, delivery, waste, emissions, or causal effect. Phase 56D keeps compatibility, attribution, validation status, denominator breaks, and alternative explanations visible.
notes: Phase 56D record for repeat outcomes and alternative-explanation tests. Collection: repeat-outcomes-alternative-explanation-tests-2010-2026.
